beats.vo_text: Ye kahani kisi social media afwaah par nahi, balki Indian Railways Official Archives — 42-year Begunkodar Station Shutdown par darj hai. West Bengal ke Purulia ziley ka ek chhota railway station jahan Santhal gaon ke log shaam ko bazaar se lautta karte the. Lekin 1967 mein Station Master Mohan Roy Purulia Division ke sath ek aisi ghatna ghati jisne is poore ilaaqe ki taqdeer badal di.

beats.vo_text: Jo log yahan se aadhi raat ko guzre hain, unhone bataya ki theek 12 bajte hi... raat ke 11:30 baje signal light achanak bina kisi operator ke green se red ho jati hai aur empty track par ghunghroo bajne lagte hain. Mobile phone ka battery percentage achanak zero ho jata hai aur tapman itna girta jaise aap kisi barfili ghaati mein khade hon.

beats.vo_text: Sabse khaufnaak hadsa tab report hua jab 1967 mein Station Master Mohan Roy ne tracks par ek aurat ko ajeeb mudra mein naachte dekha, agle din Mohan Roy aur unka pura parivar quarters mein dead mila! Tracks aur surang ke andhere se aisi aakriti achanak prakat hui jo bina zameen ko chhue hawa mein tair rahi thi! Unhone cheekh kar kaha: 'Wo platform par nahi chal rahi thi... wo train ke aage tracks par hawa mein daud rahi thi!' — aur unke paas wahan se bhaagne ke siva koi rasta nahi bacha tha!
